subject: NexaHealth evidence ask: scoped SCIM delta + SAML assertion continuity
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@nexahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@nexahealth.com
Date: 2026-09-28T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence request: SCIM delta and SAML assertion continuity for NexaHealth onboarding

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the workshop yesterday. As part of our SOC 2 intake we need a scoped bundle of access-control artifacts to validate the onboarding. Can you send the following by EOD Wednesday (48 hours):

- SCIM delta export (CSV) covering the last 90 days for our tenant (delta rows with timestamps and operation type).
- A handful of SAML assertion samples for successful and failed login attempts (include assertion timestamps and issuer).
- Role->permission mapping or RBAC manifest for service accounts and human roles (spreadsheet is fine).
- Confirmation of session retention policy and an example session assertion (how long assertions live, and any TTLs).

If any of these require a different delivery mechanism (SFTP/Drive/Signed link), let me know. We can redact PII but we need the full attribute names and timestamps to satisfy our auditors.

Appreciate a single archive if possible and an outline of the redaction approach you’ll use.

Alex Torres
Head of InfoSec, NexaHealth
alex.torres@nexahealth.com

[Attachment: onboarding-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SCIM delta and SAML assertion continuity for NexaHealth onboarding

Alex — thanks for the clear list. We'll put together a scoped package and propose the following deliverables and controls plan:

- Deliverables (ETA: 2026-09-29 15:00 PT): scim_delta_90d.csv, saml_assertion_samples.txt, redwood_role_mapping_v1.xlsx, a short readme describing redaction rules.
- Transfer: we'll upload to a gated Google Drive folder and share a time-limited link (we can also SFTP if you prefer).
- Redaction: PII (emails, usernames) will be replaced with stable pseudonyms; timestamps and attribute keys are preserved.
- Auditable trace: we'll include the SCIM sync log snippet (non-PII) and a system-generated export manifest to show exact query parameters used.

Looping in Rishi for the SCIM export and Irene for the SAML assertion samples. Ben, can you include the brief RBAC comment about service accounts?

Also: would Nexa prefer the raw assertion XML or a flattened CSV with key attributes?

Thanks — we'll aim for the 29th and ping once uploaded.

—Marissa
Director, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood_scim_export_instructions.pdf (pdf)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Torres <alex.torres@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SCIM delta and SAML assertion continuity for NexaHealth onboarding

On Tue, Sep 29, 2026 at 09:03 Marissa Cole wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the clear list. We'll put together a scoped package and propose the following deliverables and controls plan:

Uploading the first pass now to the temporary Drive folder (link will follow from Marissa). Attached to this message are:

- nexa_scim_delta_sample.csv — delta rows for a 30-day sample (we've withheld full tenant export until we confirm redaction pattern).
- redwood_role_mapping_v1.xlsx — human role and service account mapping (sheets: roles, service_accounts, notes).
- saml_assertion_samples.txt — three assertion XML samples (with IDs and timestamps).

Notes:
- We replaced principal identifiers with pseudonyms (user_0001 etc.). Real UUIDs are in a separate mapping file we can provide under NDA.
- Session TTL: default session assertion TTL is 4 hours; refresh tokens are not emitted by default for interactive flows.
- Export method: filtered SCIM export used the internal endpoint with ?since and ?tenant_id params; exact query and manifest saved in export_manifest.json (attached to Drive).

If you want the raw XMLs delivered via SFTP instead of Drive, say the word and we'll push.

—Rishi
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
[Attachments: nexa_scim_delta_sample.csv (csv), redwood_role_mapping_v1.xlsx (xlsx), saml_assertion_samples.txt (txt)]

From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@nexahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@nexahealth.com
Date: 2026-09-29T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SCIM delta and SAML assertion continuity for NexaHealth onboarding

Marissa / Rishi — perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround. The Drive delivery is fine for now. A couple quick asks before our auditor review tomorrow:

- Can you confirm the export_manifest.json includes the ?since parameter value and the tool version used?
- For the saml_assertion_samples.txt, please include one failed-auth example (we need a negative sample).
- Please confirm whether service-account mappings include delegated scopes or just role labels.

If you can drop a DocuSign link for the limited NDA regarding raw identifiers we’ll sign and then request the UUID mapping file. Otherwise the pseudonymized artifacts should be sufficient for the SOC review.

Thanks again — will review and reach out if anything else crops up.

Alex
Head of InfoSec, NexaHealth
alex.torres@nexahealth.com
